images.why: Actual OpenAI office and courtyard at 575 Florida Street, photographed in 2024. Vertical architecture suits a 9:10 crop, with lawn and paving below for text. No company signage. Source links a 3840×2880 rendition.

images.author: Jake Stangel / OpenAI
images.why: Official photograph of colleagues conversing inside OpenAI’s office, with warm daylight and a simple background. A human-focused alternative to an unsigned building. Indexed 3840-pixel rendition; keep faces above the text area.

images.author: Latent Space; individual photographer uncredited
images.why: Two people beside the giant yellow Hugging Face mascot inside the Paris office. Strong brand recognition and a compact subject grouping for portrait cropping. Original filename specifies 4032×3024; direct download could not be independently verified.

images.author: Latent Space; individual photographer uncredited
images.why: Real Hugging Face/Latent Space meetup at the Paris headquarters, with branded office decorations. Good community atmosphere, although a 9:10 crop loses people at the edges. Original filename specifies 4032×3024; direct download could not be independently verified.

images.author: ICphoto
images.why: Actual Unitree building in Hangzhou’s Binjiang district, with rooftop signage, blue sky and greenery. Building height supports portrait cropping while retaining the sign above bottom text. URL specifies 1620×1080; direct download could not be independently verified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Strongest visual match: actual London reception with Synthesia lettering on the curved desk, warm colours and architectural lighting. Leave the desk logo above the bottom overlay. Full-size file was indexed, but download and minimum dimensions remain unverified.

images.author: Synthesia; individual photographer uncredited
images.why: Official photograph of the London headquarters lounge, with Synthesia branding on screens, curved seating and greenery. Attractive office background with lower furniture suitable for text. Original-file link; download and minimum dimensions remain unverified.

images.author: Business Leader; individual photographer uncredited
images.why: Real portrait of founders Victor Riparbelli and Steffen Tjerrild, closely grouped against contemporary architecture. A practical portrait-crop fallback with faces above bottom text. Indexed 2400-pixel rendition.
